method: Figures are computed by engineering_os.orchestrator.scenario_h from the wave-metrics snapshot below (host task notifications and integrator gate logs of real agents) and, for merge times, from the first-parent history of the integration branch. Each result carries its definition. The next-wave size is economics.recommend_concurrency on the measured cohort with the host cap of a 4-CPU host. Deterministic code; no model was called.

concurrency.definition: every agent started at started_utc; an agent counts until its own duration; still-running agents count for the whole wall clock

conflicts.definition: conflict entries as listed per agent (an incident two agents report counts twice); kind by keyword: secret-scan/security scan -> security-scan-fixture

git.definition: first-parent commits of the integration branch: agent merges by subject; non-merge commits are the integrator's own; those after a merge of origin/main and before the next agent merge are attributed to main moving, the rest to agent output
